Goal: capture the live visual reference for https://boldteq.com/services/website-development so we can rebuild it 1:1 in Next.js.

Steps:
1. Check if Playwright is installed in this project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/`. Look at `playwright.config.ts` and `package.json`.
2. If installed, write a one-off Playwright script to:
   - Navigate to https://boldteq.com/services/website-development
   - Set viewport to 1440x900
   - Wait for network idle
   - Take a full-page screenshot to `/tmp/boldteq-webdev-live-1440.png`
   - Switch viewport to 375x812, take another screenshot to `/tmp/boldteq-webdev-live-375.png`
   - Extract and dump: page title, meta description, all `<section>` class names in DOM order, all `<h1>`, `<h2>`, `<h3>` text content
3. Run the script with `npx playwright test` or `node` directly (whichever fits).
4. If Playwright won't run (no chromium installed, network blocked, etc.) — fall back: use WebFetch to GET https://boldteq.com/services/website-development and extract section structure + headings text from the HTML.

Report:
- Section order on the live page (top to bottom) with their class name + 1-line purpose
- All H1/H2/H3 text exactly as written
- Any sections that exist on live but are HIDDEN in the Webflow export (class `hide`) — flag those
- Screenshot file paths if successful

Goal is to confirm our Webflow export matches what's actually live. Sometimes Webflow exports include staging-only sections marked `hide`. No fluff.
